behaviors.description: Inspect and change runtime System activation independently of retained behavior. Refuse disabling live work/resources or a System on the current invocation stack. Newly enabled Systems initialize once through registered startup hooks; failed initialization remains observable and disabled.
behaviors.selection: Explicit runtime registry requests; the source registry remains a boolean-only default selection.

checks.expectation: A disabled System can be enabled and invoked without restarting. It initializes once. Disabled invocation and disabling live resources are rejected; retention and circuit breaker state are unchanged.
checks.procedure: Exercise initially disabled activation, init failure, reenable, live-Audicle/resource rejection, and successful disable after cleanup.
